entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A place where the example Dragon Fodder spell was learned, home to goblins and coal-breathed lizards.

entities.name: Skirk Ridge
entities.description: A dusty, iron-ore cliff on Dominaria used as an example mountain mana bond.

entities.name: Dominaria

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane whose Tenth District holds a massive ash-belching foundry.

entities.name: Tenth District

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: The home of the aether-lich, undead more-etherium-than-flesh abominations.

entities.name: Aether-lich
entities.description: One of the undead, more-etherium-than-flesh abominations of Esper, whose soul is housed in an etherium phylactery.

entities.name: Immortal Coil
entities.description: An etherium phylactery used to house the soul of an aether-lich.
